Available for remote freelance projects, contracts, and technical collaboration worldwide.

## Experience

- **Software Engineer** — Pusat Jantung Nasional Harapan Kita, Jakarta (Oct 2025 – Present): HRIS ecosystem, EMR archival, E-Signature API Gateway, SATUSEHAT/HL7 FHIR R4 integration, enterprise backend infrastructure
- **Software Engineer** — RSUP H. Adam Malik, Medan (Apr 2021 – Sep 2025 · 4 yrs 6 mos): SIMRS modules (pharmacy, warehouse inventory, attendance), SATUSEHAT API integration, biometric SSO, executive dashboard
- **IT Staff** — Pengadilan Negeri Medan Kelas IA Khusus (Feb 2020 – Oct 2020): court document portal, network maintenance

## Selected Projects

- [SIRS Mandiri](https://dedeekaprasetya.com/#showcase): Integrated Hospital Information System — medical records, patient queuing, pharmacy, reporting (PHP, Laravel, MySQL)
- [JagaNakes](https://jaganakes.mylabhunter.my.id): Healthcare worker app — shift management, document wallet (STR/SIP), geofencing attendance, payroll (Flutter, Go, PostgreSQL)
- [JagaPegawai](https://jagapegawai.mylabhunter.my.id): General HRIS app — shift management, geofencing attendance, automated payroll with PPh 21 (Flutter, Go, PostgreSQL)
- [CodaMed Informatika](https://codamed.dedeekaprasetya.com): AI-powered clinical decision support — maps clinical narratives & lab reports to ICD-10 codes in under 5 seconds (React, TypeScript, Go, D3.js, Gemini API)
- [MulesMeter](https://dedeekaprasetya.com/#showcase): Android contraction monitoring app — timer, home screen widget, AI analysis offline-first (Flutter, Riverpod, Drift, Gemini API)
- [JDIH Online](https://dedeekaprasetya.com/#showcase): Legal documentation portal for Medan District Court — public access to legal documents and regulations (PHP, Yii2)
